title: The Secret Attic Library and the Starlit Key
logline: When curious Nia discovers a hidden attic library, she befriends a gentle mechanical owl and works together with him to catch a floating starlight key.

character_bible.name: Nia
character_bible.visual_appearance: 7-year-old girl with warm mahogany skin, sparkling hazel eyes, and two high afro puffs decorated with polished amber beads.
character_bible.signature_clothing: Emerald-green corduroy pinafore dress worn over a cozy mustard-yellow knit turtleneck sweater, paired with sturdy brown leather ankle boots.
character_bible.distinct_accessories: A small canvas satchel with a stitched dandelion patch across the strap.

character_bible.name: Barnaby the Clockwork Owl
character_bible.role: Loyal mechanical companion and attic guardian
character_bible.visual_appearance: A small mechanical owl forged from burnished brass and warm copper, featuring luminous amber gemstone eyes and visible miniature golden cogs along his feathered wings.

character_bible.distinct_accessories: A miniature bronze wind-up keyhole centered beneath his breastplate.

scenes.title: The Hidden Staircase
scenes.narrative_text: Behind the grandfather clock, Nia discovered a spiraling wooden staircase that twisted upward. At the very top, she pushed open an arched oak door. Gasps of wonder tumbled from her lips. She had stepped inside a secret attic library filled with towering bookshelves that gently brushed the misty clouds outside.

scenes.title: A Feathered Friend of Brass
scenes.narrative_text: Perched upon a pile of leather-bound folios sat a sleepy little sculpture. Nia tiptoed closer and gently turned the winding stem on its back. With soft clicks and whirs, the clockwork owl sprang to life. His amber gemstone eyes blinked softly, greeting Nia with a joyful flutter of brass feathers.

scenes.title: The Drifting Starlight Key
scenes.narrative_text: Barnaby pointed his wing toward the attic skylight. Drifting like a dancing firefly was a shimmering floating key, radiating pale sapphire light. It turned slowly in midair, just out of reach. Below it rested a grand, locked star-tome whose brass lock matched the drifting key's whimsical swirling teeth perfectly.

scenes.title: Taking Flight Together
scenes.narrative_text: 'We can reach it together,' Nia whispered. She folded a large map into a sturdy paper glider and launched it upward. Barnaby leapt from her shoulder, riding the warm air current above the paper glider. With a nimble clasp of his polished talons, he caught the floating key in midair!

scenes.title: A Room Full of Constellations
scenes.narrative_text: Barnaby swooped down and delivered the key. Together, they unlocked the grand book. Instantly, luminous silver constellations spilled across the attic ceiling, painting glowing whales and glittering foxes among the wooden beams. Nia giggled, holding Barnaby close. The secret library was no longer lonely; it was full of friendship and wonder.
